name: The majority voted in favour of disagreeing with a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-02-04.52.4) "*That the member for Fadden be heard now.*" In other words, they voted that Fadden MP [Stuart Robert](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/fadden/stuart_robert) (Liberal) not be heard now.
